leadText: J. Michael Tatum is an American voice actor for the English-language dub of and .
plainText:
J. Michael Tatum is an American voice actor for the English-language dub of and .

==Biography==
Tatum was born as John Michael Tatum on May 15, 1976, in McKinney, Texas. He had a stutter as a child, which prompted his speech coach to get him involved in theatre. His performances allowed him to overcome his stutter, inspiring him to become an actor. He became a voice actor with after being discovered by one of the studio's ADR directors. Tatum became involved with the during , with his major roles being and Damon. He also joined with the role of Brassius. He currently co-hosts a podcast called That Anime Show.
